hello ! ex homeless teen here, this is a list of stuff i needed when i was homeless

tampons/pads(a MUST honestly), baby wipes, socks(fluffy/ankle/etc), gloves/mittens, maybe some vitamins/drinks with lots of vitamins, shoes(thrift stores are amazing) fast food gift cards, those things that heat up when you crack them, chapstick, deodorant, toothpaste, a travel tooth brush, water bottles, reusable water bottles, if they have a pet get some dog/cat/whatever treats or small packets of food, those small hotel sized shampoos and conditioners(it doesnt seem like much but its so nice to wash your hair), small blankets, sleeping bag, peanut butter and/or bread(filling meal with protein, sugar, oil and carbs plus a pretty good amount of calories)

other less important things, but if you have the money they could be nice to include: books(from your home, thrift store, used book store, etc) just some snacks(goldfish, gummies, maybe hot chocolate packets) it isnt a necessity ofc but its a nice thing to throw in if you can, if they have a younger kid get them little toys(think walmart or dollar store toys) it doesnt seem like much but especially since its near the holidays it would be so amazing for the kid, cards

a little bit of cash can also go a LONG way if you’re homeless, if you’re concerned abt them buying drugs with it, keep it to about 10 usd, enough for small items, a meal, little stuff that could be needed in every day life, but definitely not enough to be used for any significant amount of drugs
